talents.name: Divine Intellect
talents.description: Increases your total Intellect by 2/4/6/8/10% (per rank).

talents.name: Healing Light
talents.description: Increases the amount healed by Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock by 4/8/12% (per rank). Requires 5 points in Holy.

talents.name: Spiritual Focus
talents.description: Gives Flash of Light, Holy Light and Light's Vigil a 35/70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage. Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Improved Seals
talents.description: Increases the damage done by Seals and Judgements by 5/10/15% (per rank). Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Unyielding Faith
talents.description: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects by 15/30%. Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Voice of Truth
talents.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Grants immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Reverence
talents.description: Allows 10/20/30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Unlocks Illumination. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Purifying Power
talents.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Cleanse and Purify by 10/20% and the cooldown of Exorcism and Holy Wrath by 17/33%. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Infusion of Light
talents.description: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical strikes reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light within 15 sec by 0.5/1.0 sec. Requires 15 points.

talents.name: Illumination
talents.description: Critical heals (Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, Holy Shock): 20/40/60/80/100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost. Requires Reverence maxed + 15 points.

talents.name: Divine Favor
talents.description: 37 Mana, Instant, 2 min cooldown. Your next Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock is a 100% critical. Requires 15 points.

talents.name: Divine Precision
talents.description: Increases your chance to hit with Holy spells by 6/12/18%. Requires Holy Shock + 20 points. NOTE: same tier as its requirement (r5), verify the arrow on Wowhead.

talents.name: Holy Shock
talents.description: 160 Mana, 20 yd range, Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Blasts the target for 134 Holy damage, or heals an ally for 114. Gold talent (~21 pts). Requires 20 points.

talents.name: Consecrated Ground
talents.description: Your Holy spells deal 5/10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration. Requires 20 points.

talents.name: Holy Power
talents.description: Increases the critical chance of Holy Shock and Holy Strike by 3/6/9/12/15%, and of all other spells by 1/2/3/4/5%. Requires 25 points.

talents.name: Light's Vigil
talents.description: 730 Mana, 20 yd range, 1.5 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown. Applies Light's Vigil for 30 sec; your next Holy Shock on the target has no cooldown and deals 182 Holy damage + 75% Mana refund (enemy) or heals the party for 324 (ally). One per party. Capstone (~31 pts). Requires Holy Shock + 30 points.
